summary.text: Halo is the potent magical substance of New Capenna, made from the bodies of the angels, which the city's people smoke and drink and which the families smuggle and hoard.

bio.text: After New Capenna's completion the archdemons betrayed the angels, trapping them in stasis to convert their bodies into Halo.
The Demon Lords used Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappeared.
The Adversary hoarded Halo to monopolize it, while the Cabaretti kept it flowing with a new supply unveiled at Crescendo, and the alliances between the crime families strained as it ran out.
The source of the Cabaretti's Halo was revealed to be a single teenage girl, Giada, whose Halo mended Elspeth's bones, and she later transformed into the magic of Halo to blast Ob Nixilis away.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Urabrask obtained Halo through Vivien Reid, Atraxa was sent to cut off Halo, and Halo impeded the invaders and kept Capenna's defenders safe.
Halo cannot cure Phyrexianization but can prevent conversion, and a blast of Halo left Nahiri alive but hollow, no longer a Planeswalker.

status.text: Halo remains in use against the Phyrexians in the latest stories, impeding the invaders and keeping Capenna's defenders safe.
